# Which building won a row, printed by the row itself. One branch per method,
# reached once per filled row rather than once per candidate.
# Scope: location
bag_wtp_store_winner = {
	if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_best_method = 1 } root = { set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_winner value = building_type:beer_workshop } } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_best_method = 2 } root = { set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_winner value = building_type:beer_workshop } } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_best_method = 3 } root = { set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_winner value = building_type:beer_workshop } } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_best_method = 4 } root = { set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_winner value = building_type:beer_workshop } } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_best_method = 5 } root = { set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_winner value = building_type:beer_workshop } } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_best_method = 6 } root = { set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_winner value = building_type:beer_workshop } } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_best_method = 7 } root = { set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_winner value = building_type:beer_workshop } } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_best_method = 8 } root = { set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_winner value = building_type:brewery } } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:bag_wtp_best_method = 9 } root = { set_global_variable = { name = bag_wtp_winner value = building_type:brewery } } }
